name: dev-flow-orchestrator
description: Keep Codex development tasks resumable, verifiable, and aligned across one to eight local Git repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex tasks resumable and verifiable
interface.longDescription: The current Dev Flow Orchestrator release keeps long-running Codex development resumable with task-owned change capsules, adaptive assurance obligations, and causal review across an exact set of one to eight user-prepared Git worktrees. The dev-flow-workflow/0.4.0 controller exposes one current action to one Codex, binds dev-flow-agent/0.4.0 evidence to index-exact repository-set snapshots, dispatches only the obligations derived by the closed assurance policy, and finishes every non-cancelled path with a dev-flow-delivery-dossier/0.4.0. State stays local in the model 0.4.0 namespace and never reads or mutates retained 0.2 data. Dev Flow never manages worktrees or branches, publishes Git changes, starts parallel agents, or dispatches external CI, PR, or release automation.
defaultPrompt: Start a resumable Dev Flow task for this requirement and its prepared repositories.
Resume my active Dev Flow task and continue from its authoritative next action.
Verify this task against its acceptance criteria and generate the Delivery Dossier.
